Problem400.description: Problem details. Possible codes: BAD_REQUEST, CODE_EXPIRED, CODE_INVALID.

Problem401.description: Problem details. Possible codes: CHALLENGE_EXPIRED, INVALID_CREDENTIALS, MFA_INVALID, MFA_REQUIRED, SESSION_EXPIRED, UNAUTHENTICATED.

Problem403.description: Problem details. Possible codes: ACCOUNT_DISABLED, CSRF_FAILED, EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, FORBIDDEN, ORIGIN_REJECTED.

Problem404.description: Problem details. Possible codes: NOT_FOUND, SAUNA_NOT_OFFERED, TENANT_NOT_FOUND, TENANT_SUSPENDED, WRONG_HOST.

Problem409.description: Problem details. Possible codes: CONFIGURATION_LOCKED, CONFIGURATION_NOT_LOCKED, CONFLICT, EMAIL_TAKEN, INVALID_TRANSITION, QUOTE_EXPIRED, QUOTE_MISSING, REQUEST_EXISTS, SLUG_TAKEN, STALE_CATALOG_VERSION.

Problem410.description: Problem details. Possible codes: GONE, SHARE_LINK_EXPIRED, SHARE_LINK_REVOKED.

Problem422.description: Problem details. Possible codes: DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAP, OPTION_RULES_VIOLATED, PASSWORD_POLICY, SAUNA_NOT_ASSIGNABLE, SLUG_INVALID, SLUG_RESERVED, UPLOAD_INVALID, VALIDATION_FAILED.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: CSRF token for every non-GET request: the `csrfToken` returned by GET /api/auth/session on the same host.

session.name: __Host-sk_at
